model: Combined plant: 12 C-More, 4 Modulex, 6 ECS/SmartPlate, 2 BMS II (ProtoNode points list)
equipment_type: Boiler and water heater plant gateway (multi-unit)
applies_to: A combined AERCO plant of 12 C-More boilers, 4 Modulex boilers, 6 ECS/SmartPlate water heater valves and two BMS II boiler managers on one gateway.
summary: AERCO's ProtoNode control-points workbook has a combined profile for a mixed plant: 12 C-More boilers (9 objects each), 4 Modulex boilers (10 each), 6 ECS/SmartPlate valves (7 each) and two BMS II managers (29 objects for the C-More plant, 13 for the Modulex plant), 232 Analog Values in all. Most are read-only; setpoints and Modulex direct-drive commands are writable.
notes: Taken from the sheet "12CMore-6MLX-4EC,SP-2ACS" of AERCO-ProtoNode-Control-Points.xlsx (an Excel file).
The worksheet tab is named "12CMore-6MLX-4EC,SP-2ACS", but its title and table have 6 ECS valves (addresses 17-22) and 4 Modulex boilers (13-16).
The sheet has a point label column and a Name column; the Name (unique per object) is used as the object name, and the AERCO label is in the description.
Read-only follows the sheet's Read Only check mark; unmarked objects are listed as writable.
The other sheets of the workbook (4/8/12 C-More, Modulex, ECS) repeat profiles already in the library (aerco/*-protonode), so they are not listed again.

integration.summary: Write the header setpoints to the two BMS II objects (setpt_128 for the C-More plant, setpt_228 for the Modulex plant), or per-unit setpoints and Modulex direct-drive commands where the plant is run unit by unit. Read header temperatures, boilers fired/online, each unit's fire rate, outlet temperature, status and display/error codes.

minimum_points.name: setpt_128
minimum_points.why: C-More plant header setpoint from the BMS

minimum_points.name: setpt_228
minimum_points.why: Modulex plant header setpoint from the BMS

minimum_points.name: boilerstate_1
minimum_points.why: C-More boiler 1 fire rate (repeat per boiler)

minimum_points.name: unitstat_1
minimum_points.why: C-More boiler 1 unit status (repeat per boiler)

integration.enable: The sheet marks setpt_128 / setpt_228 (network header setpoints), each C-More setpt_n (net remote setpoint), each Modulex setpt_n and boilercmd_n (requested outlet temperature and net direct drive) and each ECS rmsetpt_n as writable. It does not describe the BMS II or C-More modes needed for these to take effect.
setup: Device addresses in this profile: C-More 1-12, Modulex 13-16, ECS/SmartPlate valves 17-22, BMS II 128 (C-More plant) and 228 (Modulex plant).
The sheet title lists BACnet IP, BACnet MS/TP, Metasys N2 and LonWorks; it gives no device instance or network settings.
gotchas: Object IDs follow this combined profile only; the single-plant profiles (4/8/12 C-More, Modulex, ECS) use other IDs.
Many objects share the same AERCO point label (01-Fire Rate Out ...); the unit is in the description and in the object name suffix.
Units and ranges are not given in the sheet.
